prepkit.title: Doctor Appointment Prep Printable, Doctor Visit Planner, Medication List, Questions to Ask Doctor, Visit Notes, Low Carb PDF
prepkit.description:
WHAT IT IS

A 11-page printable kit that gets you organized before a doctor's appointment, built for anyone changing how they eat while under a doctor's care. If you're starting low-carb or carnivore and you're a little nervous about that conversation with your doctor, this is the paper that changes it. You walk in prepared, and your doctor sees a patient who's taking this seriously.

I wrote it because I've watched the same thing over and over: doctors respond well to organized patients. A clear medication list, a one-page summary of your diet change, and three good questions do more for that appointment than an hour of explaining.

WHAT'S INSIDE (10 pages, US Letter PDF)

- Cover with plain instructions for before, during, and after your visit
- Before-your-visit checklist (what to gather, what to do)
- Medications and supplements worksheet you copy straight from your pill bottles
- "My Diet Change, In One Page" summary your doctor can read in 30 seconds
- Baseline labs education sheet: what a CMP, lipid panel, A1c, and thyroid panel actually are, in plain language, with checkboxes to discuss with your doctor
- 12 questions worth asking, with room for your own
- Symptoms and changes worksheet so nothing gets forgotten in the exam room
- Visit notes page for what the doctor said and what happens next
- Between-visits "parking lot" for questions that come up later
- Full disclaimer and free resources page

WHO IT'S FOR

Anyone with an appointment on the calendar and a diet change to discuss. It was designed with women 45 and up in mind, especially those managing prescriptions and wanting their doctor on side, but it works for any patient who wants to walk in organized. It also makes a thoughtful printout for a parent you help with appointments.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD

This is a digital PDF, sized for US Letter and easy to print at home in black and white or color. No physical product will be shipped. Download it right after purchase, print it fresh for every appointment, and reuse it as often as you like for personal use.

ONE HONEST NOTE

I'm a health coach, not a doctor, and this kit is education and organization only. It never tells you what to take, what to stop, or what your results mean. Those decisions belong to you and your doctor, and this kit exists to make that conversation better. It is not medical advice.

Designed in large, easy-to-read type. No tiny print, no squinting.

bplog.title: Blood Pressure Log Printable, Blood Sugar Glucose Log Book, 4 Week Home BP Tracker with Doctor Summary Sheet, Instant Download
bplog.description:
WHAT IT IS

A printable blood pressure and glucose log built for one purpose: handing your doctor a clean, readable summary at your next visit. If your doctor said "monitor at home and bring me the numbers," this is the log they were hoping you'd bring.

Most logs are just grids. This one adds the two things that actually help your doctor: a diet-context line each week (what changed in your eating), and a one-page doctor summary sheet that condenses four weeks of readings into the single page a busy physician will actually read.

WHAT'S INSIDE (9 pages, US Letter PDF)

- Cover with plain instructions
- How to take consistent readings: standard technique education (quiet 5 minutes, feet flat, cuff position, same times daily), so your numbers are worth trusting
- 4 weekly log pages: AM and PM blood pressure, pulse, and glucose, a daily "took my meds as prescribed" checkbox, and a weekly what-changed-in-my-eating line
- The one-page doctor summary sheet for your four weeks at a glance, plus your questions
- A "call your doctor if" education page, because knowing when to pick up the phone matters
- Full disclaimer and free resources

Use both columns or just one. It works fine as a blood-pressure-only or glucose-only log.

WHO IT'S FOR

Anyone monitoring at home: because their doctor asked, because they're starting a low-carb or carnivore way of eating while on medication, or because they want their own paper trail between appointments. Designed with older adults in mind: clear layout, generous write-in space, no tiny boxes. Print extra sets and keep logging past four weeks.

INSTANT DOWNLOAD

Digital PDF, US Letter, prints cleanly in black and white. No physical product will be shipped. Download after purchase and reprint as often as you like for personal use.

ONE HONEST NOTE

I'm a health coach, not a doctor. This log records your numbers and teaches standard measurement technique. It never interprets readings, sets targets, or gives medication guidance. What your numbers mean is your doctor's call, and if you take medications, keep taking them exactly as prescribed. This is not medical advice.

Designed in large, easy-to-read type. No tiny print, no squinting.
